To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

germ line alterations of BAX were not observed in LFS families, nor were there any correlations between BAX polymorphism frequency and either TP53 status or family history of early-onset tumors in either LFS families or LFS-L.
BAX alterations are rare in LFS and LFS-L families, and are not responsible for tumors in these families.
germ line BAX alterations do not contribute to the pathogenesis of cancers in LFS or LPS-L families.
